name.ja: BB戦士267 烈火武者頑駄無

description.ja: コミックボンボンにて好評連載中の「武者烈伝」の主役キャラクターで「烈丸」の父親である「烈火武者頑駄無」のプラモデル。「初代武者ガンダム」をイメージさせる重厚な鎧を着脱で再現できます。武器は日本刀、薙刀、タネガシマライフルを装備可能です。鎧を装備しないときは、鎧同士を合体させることで台座状態を再現できます。
description.en: A plastic model of ``Rekka Musha Gundam'', the main character of ``Musha Retsuden'', which is being serialized in Comic Bonbon and is the father of ``Retsumaru''. The heavy armor reminiscent of the "first generation warrior Gundam" can be recreated by attaching and detaching it. Weapons can include a real sword, a naginata, and a tanegashima rifle. When not equipped with armor, you can recreate the pedestal state by combining the armor pieces.
